'''Annea Lavic''' was a former medical student at the [[Rhinnal State Medical Academy]] who fled to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] after she accidentally [[Death/Legends|killed]] the son of a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor's]] chief [[Aide/Legends|aide]] during a medical procedure.

==Biography==
Annea Lavic was a medical student at the [[Rhinnal State Medical Academy]]. She struggled through the [[school]]'s rigorous program and barely passed most of her progress checks. To relieve the pressure of school, Lavic turned to [[Ryll]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] and financed her drug use through [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] and minor [[Thief/Legends|theft]]. During an internship at a prominent [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]] [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]], Lavic's drug use cost her a promising medical career. The son of the resident [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor's]] chief [[Aide/Legends|aide]] was involved in a terrible [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] accident and was hospitalized. Lavic was part of the team trying to save the boy's life, but her drug addiction prevented her from concentrating. Due to her miscalculation and hurried medical procedures, she [[Death/Legends|killed]] the aide's son. Rather than face the consequences, Lavic fled the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Lavic" />

Lavic spent a whole [[Standard year/Legends|year]] hiding in backwater [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], before she tried establishing her own practice on a small colony. She fled the settlement after a bad deal with some spice [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. After that, she wandered between systems, rarely staying anywhere for long, taking on whatever patients sought her out in order to pay for room, [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], gambling debts and drug use – usually people in desperate need of discreet medical care. At some point, she caught the attention of smuggler [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]], who included Lavic in her list of contacts in the ''[[Smuggler's Handbook/Legends|Smuggler's Handbook]]''.<ref name="Lavic" />

==Personality and traits==
Wallowing in guilt about the past had given Lavic a grim outlook on life. She gave her patients the best care she possibly could, at least for someone in her condition. However, she always warned them that the result probably wouldn't be good. She spent most of her time in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] looking for passage to another [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Lavic was susceptible to depression and when it became too much for her to bear, she would spend [[Standard day/Legends|days]] in an hallucinating stupor in an alley or abandoned warehouse.<ref name="Lavic" />
